info.title: Fandango API
info.description: Licensed Fandango Showtimes and Ticketing API via Fabric Origin.

get.summary: Gets geo-location data for a city.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: 2-Letter country code.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: State code or name.

parameters.name: City
parameters.description: Name of city.

get.summary: Gets geo-location data for a postal code.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: 2-Letter country code.

parameters.name: Postalcode
parameters.description: Postal code.

get.summary: Gets display dates for a movie based on geolocation.

parameters.name: MovieId
parameters.description: The ID of the movie.

parameters.name: IdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the movie ID.

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: ZipCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the user's location.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the user's location.

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO-8601) for the display date range. Defaults to UTC now.

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: End datetime (ISO-8601) for the display date range. Defaults to no end datetime.

parameters.name: ExcludeTheaterIds
parameters.description: Comma delimited list of theaters to exclude.

parameters.name: TheaterChainCodes
parameters.description: Comma delimited list of theater chains to filter.

get.summary: Gets movie showtimes grouped by date, theater, format, and amenities.

parameters.name: MovieId
parameters.description: The ID of the movie.

parameters.name: IdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the movie ID.

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: ZipCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the user's location.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the user's location.

parameters.name: StartDisplayDate
parameters.description: Start date for the display date range. Defaults to UTC now.

parameters.name: EndDisplayDate
parameters.description: End display date. Defaults to start display date.

parameters.name: MovieId
parameters.description: The ID of the movie.

parameters.name: IdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the movie ID.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specify InTheaters or ComingSoon.

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: ZipCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the user's location.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the user's location.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return. Used in pagination.

parameters.name: Offset

get.summary: Get showtime details by showtime id.

parameters.name: ShowtimeId
parameters.description: Showtime ID for request.

parameters.name: IdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the showtime ID.

get.summary: Gets showtimes by geolocation/theater and date.

parameters.name: TheaterId
parameters.description: The ID of the theater (required if latitude/longitude or zipCode not provided).

parameters.name: TheaterIdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the theater ID.

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: ZipCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the user's location.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the user's location.

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO-8601) for the display date range. Defaults to UTC now.

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: End datetime (ISO-8601) for the display date range. Defaults to no end datetime.

parameters.name: StartDisplayDate
parameters.description: Start date for the display date range. Defaults to UTC now.

parameters.name: EndDisplayDate
parameters.description: End display date. Defaults to start display date.

parameters.name: MovieTitle
parameters.description: Filter showtimes by movie title.

parameters.name: TheaterName
parameters.description: Filter showtimes by theater name.

parameters.name: MovieId
parameters.description: Filter showtimes by movie ID.

parameters.name: MovieIdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the movie ID.

parameters.name: AmenityIds
parameters.description: Filter showtimes by amenity list (comma delimited). Only entries with amenities exactly matching this list are returned.

parameters.name: AmenityIdProvider
parameters.description: The provider for the amenity ID.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return. Used in pagination.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset index of the first item to return. Used in pagination.

get.summary: Gets theaters close to a geolocation.

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the user's location.

parameters.name: ZipCode
parameters.description: Zip code of the user's location.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the user's location.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return. Used in pagination.

parameters.name: Offset
